company.name: AnalyticaBI
company.shortDescription: Providing 360 analytics by leveraging business intelligence technology for better decision making
company.description:
We acknowledge the importance of your data and help you make the most out of them. Our main goal is to help expanding and empowering all types of businesses.
Once extracted, the data is then taken in a cleansing and an analysis process.
You’re then provided with dashboards that are readable, understandable, and, most importantly, they are reliable for making better decisions.
Using automated analysis tool, you save all the waiting time that is usually spent when using the traditional data analysis tools.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Pre Seed round raised $25,000, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $481,765 to $481,765, a 1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 75 (+0 over 90 days) and market heat at 61 (-2).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
